run_wikidata_index: run the python module to index a bz2 Wikidata dump file into a MongoDB collection
read_dump_function: create a generator that reads lines from a bz2 compressed Wikidata dump file
get_indexable_function: extract wikidata_id, english_name, sitelinks, properties, and claims from a Wikidata instance dict
index_dump_function: parse JSON lines from a Wikidata dump and yield indexable fields for each entity
review_main_batch_insert: review the main block that batches and inserts Wikidata entities into MongoDB in groups of 5000
